paragraphs: The S‑Type 3.0 V6 uses the AJ‑V6 — a 3.0‑litre V6 petrol. It was fitted from 1999 to 2008 across the X200 generation. It sits above the 2.5 V6 as the mid‑range petrol option in the S‑Type lineup. The S‑Type 3.0 V6 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Jaguar S‑Type 3.0 V6 Engine Compatibility The S‑Type 3.0 V6 uses a single engine family, the AJ‑V6, across all generations (X200). Because the engine code is consistent across the production run, there’s no risk of a mid‑generation engine change that affects fitment — but we still confirm your exact car by registration before quoting to ensure ancillaries and ECU specifications match your specific build. about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ‑V6 engines for every S-Type 3.0 V6 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the S-Type 3.0 V6 from 2023 to present. The AJ‑V6 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ‑V6 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ‑V6 rebuild.
